about: Override schedules the client gave: for a month, the stages, day counts or carrying amounts it takes instead of the rebuilt ones, in the reconciliation template's layout (ClientBookReader::TEMPLATE_HEADER). The bootstrap (step 5a, after the build) lands each as a client book, proposes every filled cell as its override with the file as its evidence, approves them under the bootstrap label (an automated approval of a committed client input, not a MAIIC approval) and builds the month again. Client Book Reconciliation Specification v1, section 6b.
